data.body:
notes from rewriting our scheduler.

1. the queue was never the bottleneck.
2. the lock around the queue was.
3. we held it across an fsync.
4. nobody noticed for two years because the disks were fast.
5. then we moved to network storage.
6. p50 went from 2ms to 90ms overnight.
7. the fix was four lines.
8. finding it took three weeks.
9. write down what your locks protect.
10. and measure before you guess.
